intro.en: Configure and inspect the plugins installed in this deployment.
intro.zh: 配置和查看本部署已安装的插件。

empty.en: This deployment exposes no plugin settings.
empty.zh: 本部署没有开放任何插件设置。

saveFailed.en: The deployment did not accept these values; they were left for you to correct.
saveFailed.zh: 本部署没有接受这些值，已保留供你修改。

invalidNumber.en: Enter a number, or leave blank to use the default.
invalidNumber.zh: 请填数字；留空表示使用默认值。

bashDescription.en: Limits every command the agent runs.
bashDescription.zh: 限制 agent 运行的每一条命令。

bashTimeoutMsHint.en: How long one command may run before it is terminated.
bashTimeoutMsHint.zh: 单条命令允许运行多久，超时即终止。

bashMaxOutputBytesHint.en: Output beyond this spills to a temporary file rather than being lost.
bashMaxOutputBytesHint.zh: 超出部分会转存到临时文件，而不是被丢弃。

agentLoopDescription.en: How the agent dispatches tool calls.
agentLoopDescription.zh: Agent 如何派发工具调用。

agentLoopMaxParallelHint.en: Upper bound on parallel-safe calls running at once within one step.
agentLoopMaxParallelHint.zh: 同一步内最多同时运行多少个可并行的调用。

webSearchApiKeyHint.en: Stored outside the settings file. Leave blank to keep the current key.
webSearchApiKeyHint.zh: 不写入设置文件。留空表示保持当前密钥。

webSearchApiKeyUnset.en: No key is configured; search is unavailable until one is.
webSearchApiKeyUnset.zh: 未配置密钥；配置之前搜索不可用。

webSearchBaseUrlHint.en: Leave blank to use the provider default.
webSearchBaseUrlHint.zh: 留空则使用提供方默认地址。

webSearchMaxUses.zh: 单次请求最多搜索次数

webSearchMaxUsesHint.en: How many times one request may search before it must answer.
webSearchMaxUsesHint.zh: 一次请求在必须作答前最多可以搜索多少次。

subagentModelSelectionDescription.en: Control which models agents may choose for subagents.
subagentModelSelectionDescription.zh: 控制 Agent 为 Subagent 选择模型的权限。

subagentModelSelectionToggle.en: Allow agents to choose models for subagents
subagentModelSelectionToggle.zh: 允许 Agent 为 Subagent 选择模型

subagentModelSelectionChoose.en: When enabled, agents can choose a provider, model, and reasoning effort for each subagent from the authorized models below. Applies only to new sessions.
subagentModelSelectionChoose.zh: 开启后，Agent 可以从下方授权模型中，为每个 Subagent 选择提供方、模型和推理强度。仅影响新会话。

subagentModelSelectionPartial.en: Some model providers could not be loaded; saved choices remain removable.
subagentModelSelectionPartial.zh: 部分模型提供方暂时无法加载；已保存的选择仍可移除。

subagentModelSelectionEmpty.en: No model provider currently advertises a model.
subagentModelSelectionEmpty.zh: 当前没有模型提供方公布模型。

subagentModelSelectionRequired.en: Select at least one model before saving.
subagentModelSelectionRequired.zh: 保存前请至少选择一个模型。

subagentModelSelectionConflict.en: Settings changed elsewhere. Discard your draft and try again.
subagentModelSelectionConflict.zh: 设置已在其他位置更新。请放弃修改后重试。

subagentModelSelectionOff.en: Subagents use configured defaults or inherit the parent agent's model. Saved model choices are retained.
subagentModelSelectionOff.zh: 关闭后，Subagent 使用配置的默认模型或继承父 Agent 的模型；已选模型会保留。
